objective: Formalize observerctl implementation-gap findings and chain them to latest implementation_drift audit artifacts.

findings.gap: Trigger-posture validation is self-derived and cannot detect mismatch.
findings.evidence: evaluate_gate_decision computes posture from target mode and compares same-derived values.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate required posture against runtime/watchdog posture source and fail closed on mismatch.

findings.gap: Lockdown checks do not validate cadence escalation semantics.
findings.evidence: Current checks rely on heartbeat status + graph existence rather than escalation-rate constraints.
findings.recommended_fix: Add explicit heartbeat/baseline cadence checks and deny with normalized lockdown reason codes.

findings.gap: security_report_ref linkage is static and not run-bound.
findings.evidence: Default constant report path and non-empty presence check only.
findings.recommended_fix: Generate run-bound report references and enforce linkage continuity with run_id.

findings.gap: Collection records miss required run-linkage envelope fields.
findings.recommended_fix: Emit required linkage fields in all collection/gate/evidence records.

findings.gap: Unknown mode handling coerces invalid state to watch instead of fail-closed denial.
findings.evidence: Invalid modes normalized to watch in state load path.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve unknown mode and deny with critical_check_failed:mode_current_unknown.

findings.gap: ops mode set lacks gate-packet freshness enforcement.
findings.evidence: Decision and to_state validated without TTL freshness requirement.
findings.recommended_fix: Add strict gate packet age threshold and deny stale packets.

findings.gap: Schema/contract-invalid paths do not consistently map to exit code 3.
findings.evidence: verify schema-failure behavior follows no-go exit semantics.
findings.recommended_fix: Map schema-invalid conditions to contract-invalid exit code 3 and add deterministic tests.

findings.gap: Source-axis vocabulary drift exists across runtime scripts.
findings.evidence: observerctl uses sim|real while related surfaces include sim|live.
findings.recommended_fix: Canonicalize runtime source axis to sim|real and document aliases if retained.

findings.gap: Some plan examples still show stale command forms.
findings.evidence: Legacy top-level command examples in baseline-plan lane.
findings.recommended_fix: Refresh docs/examples to canonical observerctl ops surface.

next_actions: Remediate OGA-01..OGA-04 with test-backed enforcement updates.
Enforce deterministic exit code contract for schema/dependency/runtime failures.
Run next implementation_drift cycle and chain-link new closure to this audit.
